derivedMetrics.rule: Distinct axes; partial components and issue states never award whole-requirement acceptance. Overlapping catalog totals are never summed.

merge.when: This accounting change itself completes normal qualified merge and actual-main commit/tree/parent plus required main check verification.

scopeClarifications: #81 and #136 are supporting/overlap links, not completion prerequisites for MTR-METRIC-01.
CLI/DCP/WEB/AUG refs map overlapping coverage; this metric capability does not accept those underlying product requirements.
A green source register can accurately report no whole product acceptance; zero acceptance does not prevent the register implementation itself becoming code-complete/tested/merged.
Evidence validation is offline coherence checking, not an authenticity attestation or live monitor.
maintainabilityAssessment: Uses existing source/roadmap/build pipeline and Node built-ins; no new runtime or production dependency.
Separates raw GitHub-identity checks into capability-delivery-evidence.mjs; exact workflow contracts are deliberately reviewed immutable metadata, not fabricated fixed progress totals.
Historical contracts preserve earlier two/four/five-job Access workflows while preventing substitution of a weaker old workflow on newer source.
Saved plugin file manifest is independently modeled; publishing source or observing package bytes cannot automatically assert backend/OAuth/UI activation.
remainingDeliveryChecks: Bind reviewed hashes and exact criteria hash to final immutable accounting candidate.
Run and retain normal local and hosted required candidate gates; reviewer did not run full heavy suite in this task.
Perform normal expected-head merge and qualify actual-main tree, parents and fresh required checks for the accounting PR.
Any later edits outside these exact hashes require a bounded delta review; no source axis is awarded by this receipt alone.
limits: Offline evidence validation checks captured-byte coherence, not GitHub authenticity or a live environment.
No full repository test suite, cross-platform/native suite, or fresh hosted accounting-candidate run was independently executed by this reviewer; parent owns those normal gates.
This review does not award acceptance to the underlying 143 product requirements, deploy a portal/backend, activate OAuth/UI state, or remove wrapper tools.
